candidates.authorityName: California Department of Fish and Wildlife

parameters.note: Closure applies only to the portions of El Estero Lake south of the Pearl Street bridge known as the Camino Aquajito Arm and the Camino El Estero finger; the remainder of the lake is not covered by this entry.

candidates.summary: The Camino Aquajito Arm and Camino El Estero finger, south of the Pearl Street bridge, are closed to all fishing year-round.

candidates.authorityName: California Department of Fish and Wildlife

parameters.note: Anglers 16 years of age or older must have a valid California sport fishing license (applies to any portions of the lake that remain open to fishing).

candidates.summary: California sport fishing license required for anglers 16+

schedule.note: CDFW's 2026 Provisional Stocking Document for Trout and Inland Salmon lists El Estero Lake (Monterey Co.) for catchable-size Rainbow Trout under the Put and Take program, with a stated release month range of January-April & December (this entry covers the January-April window). Plans are provisional; execution is not guaranteed.
